title: Regional Reservation Orbits — Launch Comms, Release Notes, and Ops Runbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Coordinate a low-friction launch of new Dedicated reservation skus for the G8x family across three new regions (eu-central-2, ap-northeast-1, sa-east-1). Deliverables: final release notes, timed customer comms, updated billing SKU mapping, ops runbook for on-call, and cross-team readiness signoffs. This ticket centralizes the messaging and sequencing for GTM, legal/billing validation, and console release coordination.
success_criteria: 1) Release notes published and linked in Console and Docs by feature-freeze date (2026-03-18). 2) Billing SKU mapping validated by Finance and Billing team with test charge in staging. 3) Support and SRE runbook reviewed + 2 on-call engineers trained. 4) Zero-sev rollouts during first 72 hours; P1 alerts identified and mitigated within SLOs. 5) <10% spike in support tickets attributable to unclear reservation UI during first week.
stakeholders: PM: Aisha Patel; Eng Lead: Priya Mehta; SRE: David Kwon; Sales Enablement: Lina Ortiz; Support Lead: Marcus Nguyen; Finance/Billing: Omar Farouk; Legal: Claire Dubois; Docs: Maya Chen
rollout_steps: 1) Feature-freeze and code freeze for reservation UI (2026-03-15). 2) Publish internal release notes draft for review (2026-03-16). 3) Billing validation window (2026-03-16 to 2026-03-20) with staged test charges. 4) Sales & SE enablement packet shared (2026-03-18). 5) Console toggle for region visibility flip (controlled rollout, 10%->50%->100% over 24h windows). 6) Monitor telemetry and support queue for 72 hours; activate rollback if latency > SLA or error rate > 2%.
release_notes_outline: Summary: New G8x reservation SKUs and regional availability. Who it impacts: customers with Dedicated reservations and new customers in listed regions. Migration path: automated reservation conversion tool + manual conversion instructions. Known limitations: initial quota defaults, transient billing invoice label changes. Technical notes: instance families included, pricing tiers, grace period for cross-region swaps.
comms_plan: Audience & channels: 1) Beta customers & high-touch accounts via direct email from CSMs (send 2026-03-18). 2) Announcement blog + docs page (publish 2026-03-19). 3) Console banner for affected customers (2026-03-20). 4) Sales enablement slack thread + AMA session (live 2026-03-21). Messaging templates are in GDrive: https://drive.company.local/d/RES-Launch-Templates. Patch notes PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1482
ops_runbook_summary: Runbook sections: pre-launch checklist, smoke tests, emergency rollback (console toggle), billing reconciliation steps, SRE playbook for reservation-attach failures. Pager routing: primary -> SRE oncall, secondary -> infra. Escalation matrix and communication templates are attached in the Confluence page: https://confluence.company.local/display/RES/Regional+Reservation+Orbits
billing_notes: Finance must sign off on SKU mappings and invoice label changes. QA steps: create staging reservation -> simulate consumption -> verify invoice line items. Finance ticket: FIN-8421. Required: confirm tax code mapping for sa-east-1 before GA.
docs_links_and_artifacts: Draft release notes: https://docs.company.local/reservations/drafts/reserv-launch-11827.md; PR for billing code update: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/2023; Console deployment manifest: https://git.company.local/infra/console/commit/7f9b12
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Billing labels mismatch causing invoice disputes. Mitigation: staged test charges + Finance signoff. Risk: Unexpected quota defaults preventing reservations. Mitigation: Increase default quotas for pilot accounts & add clear UI helper text. Risk: High support volume from regional customers unfamiliar with reservation flow. Mitigation: pre-send SE enablement + dedicated support lane for 72 hours.
review_feedback: Design review (Maya Chen): suggested clarifying reservation renaming flow in UI copy — applied and resolved in PR #1510. Legal (Claire Dubois): requested explicit GDPR data residency note for eu-central-2 — added section to release notes. SRE (David Kwon): requested additional telemetry for attach latency — instrumentation PR opened (ENG-21890).
open_questions: 1) Should we offer a 7-day free trial credit for first-time reservation purchasers in new regions? (Finance needs input). 2) Are partner reseller SKUs included in this wave? (Sales to confirm). 3) Final SLA wording for GA vs pilot customers? (Legal/Support)

post_launch_actions: Post-launch checklist: 24h debrief, public blog metrics, customer feedback triage, invoice reconciliation, and 7-day support burn rate review. Schedule postmortem at 2026-04-02 to capture learnings and adjust default quotas.
notes_for_engineering: Please prioritize instrumentation for attach latency (ENG-21890) and ensure console feature flag respects region opt-in. Coordinate rollback plan with infra ops team. Merge windows: schedule GA deployment during low-traffic hours (UTC 0200-0600).

notes: This ticket bundles the launch comms and ops readiness sequencing for three regions. Preference is to stagger GA by region if any billing or quota issue is detected during the first rollout window. Keep escalation and rollback steps rehearsed.
